_note: Recorded live. Do not hand-edit: four bugs in this repo shipped behind fixtures that shared the code's blind spot.
_reduction: Two UNIFORM transformations applied to every body, nothing else: (1) every 'links' and 'logos' array is truncated to its first element (shape preserved, repetition dropped); (2) every 'leaders' key is removed — per-game player stat leaders, display data that made one NBA season 1.4 MB. Events, competitions, competitors, seasonType, week and status are exactly as served.
